> **Platform**: iOS

# ZodiakFormContainer — `Shared/DesignSystem/Organisms/ZodiakFormContainer.swift`

> ⚠️ The type is `ZodiakFormContainer`, NOT `ZodiakFormWrapper` (does not exist).

```swift
ZodiakFormContainer { ... }   // @ViewBuilder content
```

Wraps form fields in a `VStack` with adaptive padding, `ZodiakColors.surface` background and `ZodiakRadii.s` corner radius. Automatically adjusts spacing for compact/regular width. Use inside `ZodiakActivityTemplate` or `ZodiakInputOutputTemplate` for form-based screens.
